draft.text: You came in because you have had blood in your urine and pain for about six weeks.
We found a 6 mm stone in your left kidney.
Your urine test showed a small amount of blood, but nothing else was wrong.
You passed some stones recently, which caused the blood and pain.
You will keep track of your urine output and how often you go to the bathroom.
You will be seen again to check on your progress.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have had blood in your urine and pain in your lower back for about six weeks.
The blood is bright red, like cherry Kool-Aid, and it has been coming and going.
An ultrasound showed a 6 mm stone in your left kidney, but it is not blocking anything.
A urine test found a small amount of blood, but nothing else was wrong.
You have a history of kidney stones, and this may be another episode of passing stones.
You have had pain and blood in your urine, which can happen when you pass kidney stones.
You will monitor your urine output and how often you go to the bathroom.
You will be seen again for a follow-up to check on your progress.
